layers.name: Core
layers.summary: The method’s definition and principles form the basis of the editorial identity.

layers.name: Mind
layers.summary: Decisions are checked against the canon, vocabulary, sources and conceptual dependencies.

layers.name: Body
layers.summary: The editorial system has a versioned design system, components and production tools.

layers.name: Skin
layers.summary: Expression is editorial, precise and restrained; its form adapts to the medium.

layers.name: Engines
layers.summary: Editorial production maintains generation, review and updates with defined functions.

layers.name: Brand OS
layers.summary: Decisions, permissions and versions coordinate production without silently altering the canon.

layers.name: Interconnections
layers.summary: The agent edition lets external tools consult and apply the method.

principles.name: Conceptual fidelity
principles.definition: Preserve the method’s definitions and relationships when changing format.
principles.tradeoff: Sacrifice simplification when it destroys a distinction in the canon.
principles.example: Present all seven layers with their names and functions intact.
principles.counterexample: Replace Interconnections with another layer and claim it is the book’s framework.

principles.name: Supported claims
principles.definition: Distinguish verifiable data, inferences and pending decisions.
principles.tradeoff: Sacrifice a stronger claim when it lacks support.
principles.example: Request the source of a result before stating it as fact.
principles.counterexample: Invent a sales figure to make a presentation more persuasive.

principles.name: Editorial precision
principles.definition: Express a concrete idea in Brand Machines’ editorial voice.
principles.tradeoff: Sacrifice promotional emphasis when it replaces precision.
principles.example: Describe what a tool does and the limits of its checks.
principles.counterexample: Promise absolute superiority without a verifiable comparison.

checks.suggestion: Replace unsupported superiority with a concrete, verifiable description.

checks.message: Emphasis exceeds the threshold of this editorial demonstration.
checks.suggestion: Reduce emphasis and review the precision of the message.

checks.message: The declared architecture does not match the seven canonical layers.
checks.suggestion: Preserve Core, Mind, Body, Skin, Engines, Brand OS and Interconnections.
